title: System Configurations
page_description: Internal company details and admin notification settings.
form_description: Configure company details for invoices and the admin notification email.

company_details.title: Company Details
company_details.description: Used on invoices. Falls back to website contact settings when left blank.

admin_notifications.title: Admin Notifications
admin_notifications.description: All system notification emails are sent to this address.
admin_notifications.email_hint: Overrides ADMIN_EMAIL from .env when set. Supports comma-separated addresses.

admin_branding.title: Admin Panel Branding
admin_branding.description: Logos shown in the admin sidebar and mobile header.
admin_branding.logo_hint: Displayed in the sidebar and mobile header. Recommended size: 245 × 45 px.
admin_branding.min_logo_hint: Shown when the sidebar is collapsed. Falls back to the admin logo when not set. Recommended size: 50 × 50 px.

backup.title: Automatic Backup
backup.description: Schedule database backups. Manual backups can also be created from the Backups page.
backup.enabled_hint: Uses the interval below. Requires the server cron: php artisan schedule:run
backup.interval_days_hint: Create an automatic backup every N days (1–365).
